tagline: Developing selective cortisol modulators to treat severe endocrinologic, oncologic, metabolic and neurologic disorders
hero_kpi_rationale: Relacorilant is a selective cortisol modulator for the treatment of endogenous hypercortisolism, without affinity for the progesterone receptor, eliminating critical side effects of Korlym and constituting a key element of the future growth strategy.

kpis.name: Relacorilant FDA Status
kpis.explanation: FDA approval status for the drug Relacorilant in the treatment of endogenous hypercortisolism
kpis.description: Relacorilant is a proprietary selective cortisol modulator for the treatment of endogenous hypercortisolism. The GRACE trial met its primary endpoint and the GRADIENT trial provided corroborating evidence, but the FDA has requested additional efficacy data.
kpis.signal: CRL (Complete Response Letter) decision received on December 30, 2025

kpis.name: Korlym Authorized Generic Launch
kpis.explanation: Launch of the authorized generic version of Korlym for the treatment of hypercortisolism
kpis.description: Korlym is the company's flagship drug marketed since 2012 for the treatment of hypercortisolism (Cushing's syndrome). An authorized generic version became available in June 2024.
kpis.signal: Authorized generic version launched in June 2024

kpis.name: CATALYST Trial Results
kpis.explanation: Results from the CATALYST trial demonstrating the efficacy of Korlym in treating hypercortisolism in patients with difficult-to-control diabetes
kpis.description: The CATALYST trial enrolled 1,057 patients in the first phase to determine the prevalence of hypercortisolism in patients with difficult-to-control diabetes. The second phase randomized 136 patients to Korlym or placebo. Patients on Korlym showed a clinically significant reduction in HbA1c of 1.47% versus 0.15% for placebo (p-value: 0.0001). Secondary endpoints were also met with significant reductions in body weight and waist circumference.
kpis.signal: CATALYST Phase 2 met its primary endpoint with a statistically significant reduction in HbA1c

kpis.name: MOMENTUM Trial Enrollment
kpis.explanation: Enrollment status of the MOMENTUM trial to assess the prevalence of hypercortisolism in patients with resistant hypertension
kpis.description: The MOMENTUM trial was initiated in March 2025 to determine the prevalence of hypercortisolism in patients with resistant hypertension (defined as systolic blood pressure above 130 mm Hg and diastolic above 80 mm Hg despite use of three or more antihypertensive medications). Enrollment was completed in December 2025 with over 1,000 patients.
kpis.signal: MOMENTUM trial completed enrollment of over 1,000 patients in December 2025

risks.title: Loss of revenue due to generic competition
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the 'Risks Related to our Commercial Activities' section. The company has already lost a lawsuit against a competitor (Teva). The language used emphasizes material impacts ('materially harm').

risks.title: Impact of public perception and legislation on mifepristone
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed and linked to a key active ingredient (mifepristone) used in Korlym. The post-Dobbs context and future regulatory uncertainties regarding mifepristone use justify a high severity.

risks.title: Regulatory changes and drug pricing pressures
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the 'Risks Related to our Commercial Activities' section, specifically mentioning the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) and its implications on price negotiation and rebates. Severity is high due to direct impact on revenues.

risks.title: Failure in development and approval of new products
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly stated in the 'Risks Related to our Research and Development Activities' section. The development process is described as lengthy, costly and often unsuccessful, with uncertainty regarding regulatory approval. The receipt of a CRL for Relacorilant on December 30, 2025 validates this risk.

risks.title: Dependence on revenues from current products
risks.score_rationale: This risk is the first mentioned in the commercial section and is directly related to the company's ability to generate sufficient revenue. Failure to meet revenue targets would have a direct impact on the stock price.

risks.title: Intellectual property and litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is addressed in the 'Risks Related to our Intellectual Property' section. Although the company seeks to protect its patents, the language acknowledges that litigation is costly, lengthy and uncertain.

risks.title: Failure of information systems and cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the 'General Risk Factors' and highlights the company's reliance on its information systems. An interruption or breach could lead to liabilities.

ai_positioning.summary: Corcept Therapeutics does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its annual 10-K report. There is no reference to the use of AI, research and development in this area, or AI-related products.
